Evolving AI on Instagram: "NVIDIA just announced DLSS 5, the latest version of its AI upscaling tech for games.

The new update uses improved neural rendering to generate frames, boost performance, and push visual quality closer to native rendering.

DLSS already lets games run at much higher frame rates without the same GPU cost, and this new version takes that further.

What are your thoughts on this? 🤔💬
